title: The Last Coach
author: umangk
description:
December, 1996.

Dr. Dev Malik is travelling aboard the Kashi Night Express to testify at an inquiry he has spent six months trying to avoid.

His prepared statement is missing.

Outside, winter fog has swallowed the countryside. Somewhere aboard the train, a child is coughing. An old passenger chart contains a name Dev wishes he did not remember.

And according to railway records, the train has fourteen coaches.

There may be fifteen.

A short supernatural horror story about guilt, memory, and the choices we make when the truth finally catches up with us. Features atmospheric exploration, light puzzles, an in-game hint system, meaningful choices, and multiple endings.
